new: A setting holds messages queued while the agent works until you press Send now.
Open in a new tab shows a markdown file as a page of its own; its links open there too.
The file viewer draws a README's HTML: centered logo, badges, links, details.
improved: The plan lives in the background-task button by the message box, as a list of steps.
Recent folders skip worktrees and temp folders: up to eight on one row, the rest under +N.
Why a message did not go shows as a band on the message box, with Clear it and send.
A phone back from sleep reconnects at once instead of waiting out the retry delay.
Built scripts and styles are served precompressed, so the app loads faster.
A pinned agent stays in its workspace card, and cards with pins come first.
fixed: On a phone, Back closes an open sheet or dialog instead of switching panes.
A pane shown alone on a phone no longer draws its own ellipsis over the chat.
A long press on the chat selects text and offers copy, as the phone does.
A phone showing one pane of a split tab no longer resizes the other panes' terminals.
A PC window left in front takes the pane back at its own size on a click or key.
The update line stays one row on a phone; after an update it closes with an x.
A refused answer on a question card stays visible until the card is replaced.
With reduce motion on, a running agent's arc fades in and out, so RUN reads apart from BG.

new: Deep links: the address names the PC, workspace, pane and view, and opens there.
A Claude Code or Codex plan shows as progress in the header and opens as a flow or list.
Chat reads Grok, Antigravity (experimental), Hermes and OpenCode 1.x natively.
Mermaid blocks in chat are drawn as diagrams, and the file viewer renders Markdown.
New workspace offers your three most recent folders.
Turkish joins the languages, and Colors gains the Forest palette.
improved: On a phone, sheets, the drawer and the chat move like a native app's.
A split pane under 80 columns shrinks its font so programs like btop still fit.
Chat follows the agent's transcript as it is written, not on a timer.
Terminal: pick the cursor shape, pinch to resize the font, hold an arrow to repeat it.
Anonymous counts also name the appearance settings you changed; the notice shows again.
Usage meters can show each limit's pace and when it runs out (turn it on in Settings).
fixed: A phone shows a split tab one pane at a time again, at full width.
Markdown opened in a new tab stays rendered.
A message stopped right after sending returns to the message box instead of sticking.
Push alerts stay quiet while you are using the app on any device.
Back and Forward follow a pane after it is moved.

new: Split, zoom, swap and resize panes from the web; a split tab shows all its panes at once.
Search a pane's terminal history, with highlighted matches and a history scrollbar.
The command palette works like herdr's Goto picker and runs herdr plugin actions.
Reorder tabs, and move a pane to another tab or workspace, as in herdr's own window.
Agents show the names set with herdr, and Settings lists herdr's agent integrations.
improved: Answers are compressed, so opening a long chat is faster over a slow connection.
Changes made in herdr's own window show in the web at once.
A phone that leaves the app gives the pane's size back to herdr's window right away.
fixed: Typing never reaches a pane that another connection is using.
Held messages keep Send now after you switch tabs, workspaces or PCs.
Codex chats on Windows are found even when the folder's letter case differs.
An OmO turn that ended on a model error reads READY, not DONE.
A remote PC that slept during a bridge update shows Reconnecting, not an update prompt.

improved: Desktop tabs keep updating unless you opt in to sharing panes with herdr's own window.
fixed: Claude background counts recover from transcript changes and temporary lookup failures.
Delayed Claude history keeps the turn's background wait; day-old task badges expire.
Claude completion cards no longer repeat within a chat page after incremental updates.
Selecting chat code preserves its trailing newlines, with highlighting on or off.

new: Follow Claude Code subagents and background commands directly in chat.
Choose a dictation language and give each PC's installed app its own name.
Reorder workspaces by touch and read highlighted code and task lists in chat.
improved: Find slash commands by name fragments, descriptions or matching letters.
fixed: Claude turns waiting for background work no longer announce an early finish.
Inactive browser tabs release panes so herdr's terminal view keeps its size.
Fast typing around chat completions keeps every key and selection in place.
Open worktrees from linked checkouts and read short, identifiable Codex sessions.

improved: omp panes started with a profile, or running for a long time, show their chat
A remote PC lists a pane's new agent at once, after its bridge is updated
fixed: Claude panes show their chat on Macs with a non-US time format, such as Korean
A queued chat message is no longer pasted over what you are typing in Claude Code's box
Arrow keys work in less, git log and man, and clicks reach programs that read the mouse
Claude Code 2.1.29x approvals and questions show as cards again
Copy buttons in the chat work on plain-HTTP LAN addresses
An alert chimes once across open tabs, and is still heard if that tab closes
A tab left open in the background no longer resizes the pane you are using elsewhere
The plugin finds Bun when herdr starts from a GUI app; reinstall the plugin through herdr

new: Installs and updates are counted anonymously; Settings → About shows it and turns it off
Clicking an agent's notification opens that pane on its chat, where the answer is
Devin CLI panes show their conversation in the chat
OpenCode 2 panes read as a conversation in the chat; OpenCode 1.x keeps the terminal text
A message Claude Code holds back for invisible characters shows a card to send or discard
improved: The phone key bar starts with Esc, Tab and Ctrl+C; saved layouts keep their order
Settings → Shortcuts explains the app's keys and marks keys the browser or OS keeps
vim, tmux and Claude Code in a pane copy to your clipboard again, no trip to Settings
The website moved to herdrweb.dev and reads in Simplified Chinese; old links still work
GitHub releases open with short patch notes like these
fixed: Typing Korean in Safari no longer loses syllables, also after switching from English
An unknown slash command in a Claude Code chat shows Claude's answer instead of vanishing
Palette shortcut hints follow your bindings, and shortcuts work on non-Latin keyboards
Quiet opened finishes works even if the browser kept a damaged record of opened agents

new: Typing /effort in a Claude Code chat opens a card to pick the effort for this session
Settings → Appearance can keep waiting and the latest agents on top of the Agents list
A finished agent you opened in the web UI can lose its dot, as it would in herdr (opt-in)
The guide shows how to give the app a public HTTPS address with Portal
improved: A wrong access token waits longer after five tries, up to a minute
A program in a pane copies to your clipboard only once you allow it in Settings → Terminal
Dialogs keep Tab inside them, and screen readers announce tabs, panes and status lines
Add PC, Reconnect PC and Update remote bridge open as a bottom sheet on a phone
Updating a remote PC that is already current reuses its bridge without a new download
Alerts go only to https push services and never follow a redirect
Long drafts wrap, and the scrollbar no longer covers text when the page is zoomed
fixed: A long line of unclosed brackets or broken escape codes no longer freezes the chat
On Windows, more Claude Code and Codex panes show their chat instead of an error
Your own devices are recognised by their Tailscale login again, without pairing
A Claude Code chat shows what a slash command answered, and /goal is suggested
Settings, the palette, Add PC and file previews stack in order; Escape closes the top one
The plugin's start keeps the app on its port while herdr is away
A secret or typed text no longer reaches a pane you have already left
Gajae Code's selection and startup menus show their choices, not only arrow keys

new: Settings shows one page at a time, with a list of pages beside it on a desktop
An update tells what it brings before it installs, and what it brought once it runs
Release notes read like patch notes: new features, improvements and bug fixes
The mobile key bar can be edited: add, remove and reorder keys, save Ctrl/Alt combinations
Sticky Ctrl, Alt and Shift on the mobile key bar, and an Enter key
The sidebar can be resized, and a right-click opens a row's menu
The installers can give the GitHub star for you when gh is signed in, only on your yes
improved: One Send/Stop button in every chat; a message sent during work goes at the next turn
Sidebar rows show what each agent is doing, with the workspace and folder under it
The sidebar follows herdr's workspaces and agents on one grid, worktrees under their repo
A waiting agent is marked with a red question mark, a finished one with a green dot
The mic button appears in a desktop's chat where dictation can work; Auto, On or Off
The chat's message box follows the chat font size
A phone's Agents list starts folded, and the suggestion chip is on by default
fixed: A message can no longer freeze or crash the chat by its shape
In-app alerts and their sound are no longer lost now and then
A pane whose agent just started is listed as an agent's pane at once
A question asked after a numbered message shows as a question card again
The Claude usage meter shows per-model weekly limits such as Fable's
Your own phone gets in through tailscale serve without a pairing code (opt-in)
The held-input notice shows only text to send, and tells when text was too long to hold
